rv.q: It is an enthralling, titillating and wildly imaginative production.
Mostly, Holmström takes the material seriously, touching on meaty themes of sexual exploitation, the price of ambition and the liberating power of embracing your desires.

The puppetry is novel with hilarious rough edges, Collins' text is vivid, and its critique of misogyny – while simply expressed and reinforced on multiple occasions – is thought-provoking and impactful.

cn.t: Critics praise this inventive puppet adaptation of Jackie Collins' novel for its surreal blend of explicit sexuality and surprising sincerity, with dollhouse staging that's simultaneously ludicrous, provocative, and poignant.
